title: Jazzy Norwegian Banana Bowl
description: A tangy, cheese-pull post-workout Norwegian dish featuring banana, confit tomato, and shojin-friendly ingredients served in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Place the sliced banana at the bottom of a lacquerware bowl.
Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced confit tomato to the skillet and sauté for 2 minutes until heated through.
Pour the sautéed tomato over the banana slices in the bowl.
Sprinkle the cubed Norske Havarti cheese over the tomato layer.
Drizzle maple syrup evenly across the cheese for a subtle sweetness.
Sprinkle lemon zest, chopped dill, salt, and pepper over the bowl.
Cover the bowl with a tight-fitting lid and let the cheese melt for 2-3 minutes by the residual heat.
Serve immediately, enjoying the tangy, cheese-pull texture, ideal for a post-workout snack.
